translations.idiomatic: Moreover as name and position differ, ritual also has differing grades.

sentences.zh: 天子七廟，事著前經；

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven has seven temples—this is set forth in former classics;
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven has seven temples—this is set in former classics;

sentences.zh: 諸侯二昭，義有差降。

translations.literal: feudal lords have two zhao—meaning has graded descent.
translations.idiomatic: feudal lords have two zhao—meaning has graded descent.

sentences.zh: 故知以多為貴，王者之禮，今可依用，貽厥後昆。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that taking many as honorable is the ritual of a king—now it may be followed and used, bequeathed to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows taking many as honorable is a king's ritual—now it may be followed and bequeathed to later generations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次榆林郡。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, he halted at Yulin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he halted at Yulin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，啟民可汗來朝。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Qimin Khan came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Qimin Khan came to court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，吐谷渾、高昌並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上御北樓，觀漁於河，以宴百僚。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Emperor mounted the North Tower, watched fishing on the river, and feasted the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Emperor mounted the North Tower, watched fishing on the river, and feasted the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，啟民可汗上表請變服，襲冠帶。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinhai, Qimin Khan submitted a memorial asking to change dress and adopt cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month seven, on xinhai, Qimin Khan asked to change dress and adopt cap and belt.

sentences.zh: 詔啟民贊拜不名，在諸侯王上。

translations.literal: An edict said Qimin in congratulatory bow was not to be named, ranking above feudal princes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said Qimin in congratulatory bow was not to be named, ranking above feudal princes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上於郡城東禦大帳，其下備儀衛，建旌旗，宴啟民及其部落三千五百人。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, east of the commandery city the Emperor faced the great tent; below were full guards and banners, feasting Qimin and his tribe of three thousand five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, east of the commandery city the Emperor faced the great tent with full guards and banners, feasting Qimin and his tribe of three thousand five hundred.

sentences.zh: 奏百戲之樂，賜啟民及其部落各有差。

translations.literal: The hundred entertainments were played; Qimin and his tribe were rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred entertainments were played; Qimin and his tribe were rewarded in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙子，殺光祿大夫賀苦弼、禮部尚書宇文弼、太常卿高颎。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness He Kubu, Minister of Rites Yuwen Bi, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Gao Feng were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Grand Master He Kubu, Minister of Rites Yuwen Bi, and Grand Master Gao Feng were killed.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射蘇威坐事免。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Wei was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Su Wei was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 發丁男百餘萬築長城，西鉅榆林，東至紫河，二旬而罷，死者十五六。

translations.literal: More than a million laborers were drafted to build the Long Wall from great Yulin in the west to the Purple River in the east; it stopped after twenty days, and fifteen or sixteen in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: More than a million laborers built the Long Wall from Yulin west to the Purple River east; after twenty days it stopped, and fifteen or sixteen in ten died.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，車駕發榆林。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the eighth month the imperial carriage departed Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of month eight, the imperial carriage left Yulin.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，啟民飾盧清道以候乘輿，帝幸其帳。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Qimin decorated his camp and cleared the road to await the imperial carriage; the Emperor visited his tent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Qimin decorated his camp and cleared the road; the Emperor visited his tent.

sentences.zh: 啟民奉觴上壽，宴賜極厚。

translations.literal: Qimin offered the cup and wished long life; the feast and gifts were extremely generous.
translations.idiomatic: Qimin offered the cup and wished long life; feast and gifts were extremely generous.

sentences.zh: 上謂高麗使者曰：「歸語爾王，當早來朝見。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to the Goguryeo envoy: "Return and tell your king he should come early to court.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told the Goguryeo envoy, "Tell your king to come to court early.

sentences.zh: 不然者，吾與啟民巡彼土矣。

translations.literal: If not, I shall tour that land with Qimin.
translations.idiomatic: If not, I shall tour that land with Qimin.

sentences.zh: 」皇后亦幸義城公主帳。

translations.literal: " The empress also visited Princess Yicheng's tent.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress also visited Princess Yicheng's tent.

sentences.zh: 己丑，啟民可汗歸蕃。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Qimin Khan returned to his domain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Qimin Khan returned to his domain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，入樓煩關。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, he entered Loufan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, he entered Loufan Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次太原，詔營晉陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, he halted at Taiyuan; an edict ordered construction of the Jinyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, he halted at Taiyuan; an edict ordered the Jinyang Palace built.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，次濟源，幸御史大夫張衡宅，宴享極歡。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the ninth month, he halted at Jiyuan and visited Grand Master of the Palace Zhang Heng's house, feasting with utmost joy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of month nine, he halted at Jiyuan and visited Grand Master Zhang Heng's house, feasting with utmost joy.

sentences.zh: 己巳，至於東都。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he arrived at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, he arrived at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以齊王暕為河南尹、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Prince of Qi Yang was appointed Governor of Henan and Palace Attendant of the First Rank with equal ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince Yang of Qi became Governor of Henan and Palace Attendant of the First Rank with equal ceremony.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以戶部尚書楊文思為納言。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Minister of Revenue Yang Wensi was appointed Chief Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Minister Yang Wensi became Chief Counselor.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙巳，詔發河北諸郡男女百餘萬開永濟渠，引沁水南達於河，北通涿郡。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day yisi, an edict drafted more than a million men and women from Hebei commanderies to open the Yongji Canal, drawing the Qin River south to the Yellow River and north to Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, month one, year four, on yisi, an edict drafted more than a million from Hebei to open the Yongji Canal, drawing the Qin south to the river and north to Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，百僚大射於允武殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the hundred officials held the great archery contest at Yunwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the hundred officials held the great archery contest at Yunwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜城內居民米各十石。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, residents within the walls were each given ten shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, city residents each received ten shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以太府卿元壽為內史令，鴻臚卿楊玄感為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Grand Master of the Imperial Storehouse Yuan Shou was appointed Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Herald Yang Xuanggan Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Storehouse Grand Master Yuan Shou became Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Herald Yang Xuanggan Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以工部尚書衛玄為右武候大將軍，大理卿長孫熾為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Minister of Works Wei Xuan was appointed Right Martial Guard Commander-in-Chief, and Court Review Grand Judge Zhangsun Chi Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Minister Wei Xuan became Right Martial Guard commander, and Review Grand Judge Zhangsun Chi Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，遣司朝謁者崔毅使突厥處羅，致汗血馬。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the second month, Court Usher Cui Yi was sent as envoy to the Turk Chuluo to obtain blood-sweating horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of month two, Usher Cui Yi was sent to Turk Chuluo for blood-sweating horses.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以將作大匠宇文愷為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the third month, Master of Works Yuwen Kai was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of month three, Master of Works Yuwen Kai became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，百濟、倭、赤土、迦羅含國並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Baekje, Wa, Chitu, and Karahan all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Baekje, Wa, Chitu, and Karahan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕幸五原，因出塞，巡長城。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the imperial carriage visited Wuyuan and went beyond the frontier to tour the Long Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the imperial carriage visited Wuyuan and went beyond the frontier to tour the Long Wall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣屯田主事常駿使赤土，致羅罽。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Garrison Agriculture Chief Chang Jun was sent as envoy to Chitu to present silk gauze.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Garrison Agriculture Chief Chang Jun was sent to Chitu with silk gauze.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，以離石之汾源、臨泉，雁門之秀容為樓煩郡。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingwu, Fenyuan and Linquan of Lishi and Xiurong of Yanmen were made Loufan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month four, on bingwu, Fenyuan and Linquan of Lishi and Xiurong of Yanmen became Loufan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 起汾陽宮。

translations.literal: The Fenyang Palace was raised.
translations.idiomatic: The Fenyang Palace was raised.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以河內太守張定和為左屯衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Governor of the Interior Zhang Dinghe was appointed Left Garrison Guard Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Interior Governor Zhang Dinghe became Left Garrison Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「突厥意利珍豆啟民可汗率領部落，保附關塞，遵奉朝禮，思改戎俗。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict said: "Qimin Khan Yilibianzhen of the Turks leads his tribe, clings to the passes, obeys court ritual, and wishes to change barbarian custom.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict said, "Qimin Khan Yilibianzhen leads his tribe, clings to the passes, obeys court ritual, and wishes to change barbarian custom.

sentences.zh: 頻入謁覲，屢有陳請。

translations.literal: He has repeatedly entered audience and often made petitions.
translations.idiomatic: He has repeatedly entered audience and often petitioned.

sentences.zh: 以氈墻毳幕，事窮荒陋；

translations.literal: Felt walls and feather curtains—affairs end in wilderness and baseness;
translations.idiomatic: Felt walls and feather curtains—affairs end in wilderness and baseness;

sentences.zh: 上棟下宇，願同比屋。

translations.literal: rafters above and rooms below—he wishes to share the same houses.
translations.idiomatic: rafters above and rooms below—he wishes to share the same houses.

sentences.zh: 誠心懇切，朕之所重。

translations.literal: His sincere heart is earnest—this is what I weight.
translations.idiomatic: His sincere heart is earnest—this is what I weight.

sentences.zh: 宜於萬壽戍置城造屋，其帷帳床褥以上，隨事量給，務從優厚，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: At Wanshou Fort a city and houses should be built; curtains, bedding, and above should be given according to need, striving for generous treatment that accords with my intent."
translations.idiomatic: At Wanshou Fort a city and houses should be built; curtains, bedding, and more given by need, generously, as I intend."

sentences.zh: 」五月壬申，蜀郡獲三足烏，張掖獲玄狐，各一。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, on the day renshen, Shu Commandery obtained a three-legged crow and Zhangye obtained a black fox, one each.
translations.idiomatic: " In month five, on renshen, Shu obtained a three-legged crow and Zhangye a black fox, one each.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，發丁男二十餘萬築長城，自榆林谷而東。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinsi, more than two hundred thousand laborers were drafted to build the Long Wall east from Yulin Valley.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month seven, on xinsi, more than two hundred thousand laborers built the Long Wall east from Yulin Valley.

sentences.zh: 乙未，左翊衛大將軍宇文述破吐谷渾於曼頭、赤水。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Left Wing Guard Commander-in-Chief Yuwen Shu defeated Tuyuhun at Mantou and Chishui.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Left Wing Guard Commander Yuwen Shu defeated Tuyuhun at Mantou and Chishui.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，親祠恒嶽，河北道郡守畢集。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Emperor personally sacrificed at Mount Heng; governors of the Hebei circuit all gathered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Emperor sacrificed at Mount Heng; Hebei governors all gathered.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，車駕所經郡縣，免一年租調。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; commanderies and counties the carriage passed were exempted one year's rent and levy.
translations.idiomatic: General amnesty was proclaimed; commanderies the carriage passed were exempted one year's rent and levy.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，征天下鷹師，悉集東京，至者萬餘人。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the ninth month, falconers from all under Heaven were conscripted and all gathered at the Eastern Capital—more than ten thousand arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of month nine, falconers from the realm were gathered at the Eastern Capital—more than ten thousand came.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wa sent an envoy with tribute.

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the second month, Martial Guard Officer Chen Leng and Grand Master Zhang Zhenzhou attacked Liushui and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of month two, Officer Chen Leng and Grand Master Zhang Zhenzhou defeated Liushui.

sentences.zh: 獻俘萬七千口，頒賜百官。

translations.literal: Captives of seventeen thousand mouths were presented; the hundred officials were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen thousand captives were presented; the hundred officials were rewarded.

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict said: "In founding the imperial design and establishing royal enterprise, all relied on arms and legs sharing one heart and virtue;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict said, "Founding the throne and royal enterprise relied on ministers sharing one heart;

sentences.zh: 用能救厥頹運，克膺大寶。

translations.literal: by this they could rescue the failing fortune and grasp the great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: by this they rescued failing fortune and grasped the throne.

sentences.zh: 然後疇庸茂賞，開國承家；

translations.literal: Then merit was ranked and rewards were lush, founding states and inheriting houses;
translations.idiomatic: Then merit was ranked and rewards lush, founding states and inheriting houses;

sentences.zh: 誓以山河，傳之不朽。

translations.literal: sworn on mountains and rivers, transmitted without perishing.
translations.idiomatic: sworn on mountains and rivers, transmitted without perishing.

sentences.zh: 近代雕喪，四海未壹。

translations.literal: In recent times carving and loss, the four seas were not one.
translations.idiomatic: In recent loss, the four seas were not one.

sentences.zh: 茅土妄假，名實相乖；

translations.literal: Fief soil was falsely granted, name and reality opposed;
translations.idiomatic: Fief soil was falsely granted, name and reality opposed;

sentences.zh: 歷茲永久，莫能懲革。

translations.literal: through these long years none could punish and reform.
translations.idiomatic: through long years none could reform.

sentences.zh: 皇運之初，百度伊始，猶循舊貫，未暇改作。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the imperial fortune, the hundred measures just began, still following the old rule, without leisure to change.
translations.idiomatic: At fortune's beginning, measures just began, still following old rule without leisure to change.

sentences.zh: 今天下交泰，文軌攸同。

translations.literal: Now all under Heaven is peaceful and writing and wheels are one.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is peaceful and writing and wheels are one.

sentences.zh: 宜率遵先典，永垂大訓。

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow former canon and eternally hand down great instruction.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to follow former canon and hand down great instruction.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，唯有功勛，乃得賜封，仍令子孫承襲。

translations.literal: From now onward, only those with achievement and merit may receive enfeoffment, and still let sons and grandsons inherit.
translations.idiomatic: From now, only achievement may receive enfeoffment, sons and grandsons inheriting.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，改封安德王雄為觀王，河間王子慶為郇王。

translations.idiomatic: " On bingchen, Prince Xiong of Ande became Prince of Guan, and Prince Qing of Hejian's son became Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 庚申，征魏、齊、周、陳樂人，悉配太常。

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wei, Qi, Zhou, and Chen musicians were conscripted to the Grand Music Office.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，幸江都宮。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the third month, he visited Jiangdu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of month three, he visited Jiangdu Palace.

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Grand Herald Shi Xiang was appointed Left Valiant Cavalry Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Grand Herald Shi Xiang became Left Valiant Cavalry commander.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，宴江、淮已南父老，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingwei, elders south of the Jiang and Huai were feasted and rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month four, on dingwei, elders south of Jiang and Huai were feasted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，室韋、赤土並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the sixth month, Shimo and Chitu both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of month six, Shimo and Chitu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雁門賊帥尉文通，聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷，遣鷹揚楊伯泉擊破之。

translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yanmen bandit Wei Wentong held Mobi Valley with three thousand; Yang Boquan defeated them.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，制江都太守，秩同京尹。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, a statute made the Jiangdu governor's rank equal to the capital intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jiangdu governor's rank equaled the capital intendant.

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on the day renshen, Minister of Punishments Liang Pi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renshen, Minister Liang Pi died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，戶部尚書、銀青光祿大夫長孫熾卒。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Minister of Revenue, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhangsun Chi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Minister Zhangsun Chi died.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，左光祿大夫、吏部尚書牛弘卒。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Minister of Civil Office Niu Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of month twelve, Grand Master Niu Hong, Minister of Civil Office, died.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhuyai Wang Wanchang rebelled; Longxi governor Han Hong pacified them.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬寅，左武衛大將軍、光祿大夫、真定侯郭衍卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the day renyin, Left Martial Guard Commander-in-Chief, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Marquis of Zhending Guo Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, month one, year seven, on renyin, Commander Guo Yan of Zhending died.

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the second month, the Emperor ascended the fishing terrace, faced Yangzi Ford, and greatly feasted the hundred officials with rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of month two, the Emperor ascended the fishing terrace, faced Yangzi Ford, and feasted the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 庚申，百濟遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Baekje sent an envoy to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Baekje sent an envoy to court.

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Emperor from Jiangdu boarded the dragon boat into the Tongji Canal and then visited Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, from Jiangdu he boarded the dragon boat into the Tongji Canal and visited Zhuo Commandery.

translations.literal: On the day renwu an edict said: "In war there are seven virtues, the first of which is settling the people;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict said, "War has seven virtues, first settling the people;

translations.literal: in government there are six roots, raising them through teaching and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: in government six roots, raising them through teaching and righteousness.

translations.literal: Goguryeo has failed in vassal ritual; I shall question their crime on the left of Liao and spread victorious strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo failed vassal ritual; I shall question their crime east of Liao and spread strategy.

sentences.zh: 雖懷伐國，仍事省力。

translations.literal: Though bearing a punitive state, still the matter saves labor.
translations.idiomatic: Though bearing punitive war, still the matter saves labor.

sentences.zh: 今往涿郡，巡撫民俗。

translations.literal: Now going to Zhuo Commandery to tour and comfort local custom.
translations.idiomatic: Now going to Zhuo to tour and comfort custom.

translations.idiomatic: Of Hebei, Shanxi, and Shandong, those ninety and above receive honorary governor;

translations.literal: eighty and above, honorary magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: eighty and above, honorary magistrate.

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the third month, Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Left Garrison Guard Commander-in-Chief Yao Bian died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of month three, Grand Master Yao Bian died.

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengwu, he visited Linshuo Palace of Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month four, on gengwu, he visited Linshuo Palace of Zhuo.

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the fifth month, Governor of Wuwei Fan Zigai was appointed Minister of the People.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of month five, Wuwei governor Fan Zigai became Minister of the People.

sentences.zh: 秋，大水，山東、河南漂沒三十餘郡，民相賣為奴婢。

translations.literal: In autumn, great floods; more than thirty commanderies of Shandong and Henan were inundated, and people sold one another as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, great floods; more than thirty Shandong and Henan commanderies flooded, and people sold one another as slaves.

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on the day yimao, Mount Dizhu collapsed and the leaning water reversed flow for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yimao, Mount Dizhu collapsed and water reversed tens of li.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以東平太守吐萬緒為左屯衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Governor of Dongping Tu Wanxu was appointed Left Garrison Guard Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Dongping governor Tu Wanxu became Left Garrison Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，突厥處羅多利可汗來朝，帝大悅，接以殊禮。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the twelfth month, the Turk Chuluo Dolikhan came to court; the Emperor was greatly pleased and received him with special ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of month twelve, Turk Chuluo Dolikhan came to court; the Emperor received him with special ritual.

translations.idiomatic: Liaodong soldiers and transport bearers clogged the road day and night.

translations.literal: Those suffering forced labor first became bandit groups.
translations.idiomatic: Those suffering forced labor first became bandits.

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an order said commandants and valiant hawks should together with prefectures and counties pursue and capture, beheading on capture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, commandants and valiant hawks with prefectures and counties should pursue and behead on capture.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛巳，大軍集於涿郡。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on the day xinsi, the great army gathered at Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, month one, year eight, on xinsi, the great army gathered at Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書段文振為左候衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Minister of War Duan Wenzhen was appointed Left Martial Guard Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Duan Wenzhen became Left Martial Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，下詔曰：天地大德，降繁霜於秋令；

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict said: Heaven and earth's great virtue sends heavy frost in autumn's command;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict said: Heaven and earth's great virtue sends heavy frost in autumn;

sentences.zh: 聖哲至仁，著兵甲於刑典。

translations.literal: the sage's utmost benevolence sets armor in the canon of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: the sage's utmost benevolence sets armor in the canon of punishments.

sentences.zh: 故知造化之有肅殺，義在無私；

translations.literal: Thus one knows creation has its stern killing, meaning lies in selflessness;
translations.idiomatic: Thus creation has stern killing, meaning lies in selflessness;

sentences.zh: 帝王之用干戈，蓋非獲已。

translations.literal: an emperor-king's use of weapons is surely not by choice.
translations.idiomatic: an emperor's use of weapons is surely not by choice.

sentences.zh: 版泉、丹浦，莫匪龔行；

translations.literal: At Banyuan and Danpu, none were not campaigns of punishment;
translations.idiomatic: At Banyuan and Danpu, all were campaigns of punishment;

sentences.zh: 取亂覆昏，咸由順動。

translations.literal: taking disorder and overthrowing darkness—all followed compliant movement.
translations.idiomatic: taking disorder and overthrowing darkness—all followed compliant movement.

translations.literal: How much more when at Sweet Marsh one swore the host—Xia Qi inherited Yu the Great's enterprise;
translations.idiomatic: At Sweet Marsh the host swore—Xia Qi inherited Yu's enterprise;

translations.literal: at Shang's outskirts guilt was questioned—Zhou Fa completed King Wen's aim.
translations.idiomatic: at Shang's outskirts guilt was questioned—Zhou Fa completed Wen's aim.

sentences.zh: 永監載籍，屬當朕躬。

translations.literal: Eternally mirroring the records, it falls on my person.
translations.idiomatic: Eternally mirroring records, it falls on me.

sentences.zh: 粵我有隋，誕膺靈命。

translations.literal: Our Sui was born receiving the numinous mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Our Sui was born receiving the numinous mandate.

sentences.zh: 兼三才而建極，一六合而為家。

translations.literal: Joining the three powers to establish the pole, the six harmonies as one house.
translations.idiomatic: Joining three powers to establish the pole, six harmonies as one house.

translations.literal: Where the map's border reaches, beyond Fine Willow and Flat Peach;
translations.idiomatic: Where the border reaches, beyond Fine Willow and Flat Peach;

sentences.zh: 聲教爰暨，紫舌、黃枝之域。

translations.literal: transforming teaching extends to purple tongue and yellow branch lands.
translations.idiomatic: transforming teaching extends to purple tongue and yellow branch lands.

sentences.zh: 遠至邇安，罔弗和會；

translations.literal: Far reached and near secure, none not harmonized;
translations.idiomatic: Far and near secure, all harmonized;

sentences.zh: 功成理定，於是乎在。

translations.literal: achievement complete and order settled—there it lies.
translations.idiomatic: achievement complete and order settled—there it lies.

translations.literal: Yet Goguryeo, a petty villain, is deluded and unrespectful.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Goguryeo, a petty villain, is deluded and disrespectful.

translations.literal: Massing between Bo and Jie, devouring the lands of Liao and Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Massing between Bo and Jie, devouring Liao and Hui.

sentences.zh: 雖復漢、魏誅夷，巢窟暫擾；

translations.literal: Though Han and Wei executed and exterminated, nests were briefly disturbed;
translations.idiomatic: Though Han and Wei exterminated them, nests were briefly disturbed;

sentences.zh: 亂離多阻，種落還集。

translations.literal: through disorder and many obstacles, tribes gathered again.
translations.idiomatic: through disorder, tribes gathered again.

sentences.zh: 萃川藪於前代，播實繁以迄今。

translations.literal: gathering in rivers and marshes from former ages, sowing seed thick to the present.
translations.idiomatic: gathering in rivers and marshes from former ages, sowing thick to now.

sentences.zh: 眷彼華壤，翦為夷類。

translations.literal: Cherishing that Hua soil, cutting it into barbarian kind.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing Hua soil, cutting it into barbarian kind.

sentences.zh: 歷年永久，惡稔既盈；

translations.literal: Years long and permanent, evil ripe and full;
translations.idiomatic: Years long, evil ripe and full;

sentences.zh: 天道禍淫，亡征已兆，亂常敗德，非可勝圖；

translations.literal: Heaven's Way punishes excess, omens of perishing already appear; violating constants and ruining virtue—not to be plotted in full;
translations.idiomatic: Heaven punishes excess, perishing omens appear; violating norms and ruining virtue—not fully plottable;

sentences.zh: 掩慝懷奸，唯日不足。

translations.literal: hiding evil and harboring treachery, never enough in a day.
translations.idiomatic: hiding evil, never enough in a day.

sentences.zh: 移告之嚴，未嘗面受；

translations.literal: the sternness of transferred notices, never received face to face;
translations.idiomatic: stern notices never received face to face;

sentences.zh: 朝覲之禮，莫肯躬親。

translations.literal: court audience ritual, unwilling to attend in person.
translations.idiomatic: court audience, unwilling to attend in person.

sentences.zh: 誘納亡叛，不知紀極；

translations.literal: enticing and accepting fugitive rebels, knowing no limit;
translations.idiomatic: enticing fugitive rebels, knowing no limit;

sentences.zh: 充斥邊垂，亟勞烽候。

translations.literal: filling the border marches, repeatedly tiring beacon guards.
translations.idiomatic: filling borders, repeatedly tiring beacons.

sentences.zh: 關析以之不靜，生人為之廢業。

translations.literal: passes and markets thereby unrestful, living people thereby lost their trades.
translations.idiomatic: passes unrestful, people lost their trades.

sentences.zh: 在昔薄伐，已漏天網。

translations.literal: In the past on thin campaign, already leaking Heaven's net.
translations.idiomatic: Past thin campaigns already leaked Heaven's net.

sentences.zh: 既緩前禽之戮，未即後服之誅。

translations.literal: Having slackened punishment on birds caught before, not at once punishing those who submitted after.
translations.idiomatic: Slackened on birds caught before, not punishing later submission.

sentences.zh: 曾不懷恩，翻其長惡。

translations.literal: They never cherished grace but turned their long evil.
translations.idiomatic: They never cherished grace but turned long evil.

translations.literal: Then they joined the Khitan faction.
translations.idiomatic: Then they joined the Khitan faction.

translations.literal: earnestly slaughtering coastal garrisons;
translations.idiomatic: earnestly slaughtering coastal garrisons;

sentences.zh: 習鞨靺之服，侵軼遼西。

translations.literal: accustomed to Mohe dress, raiding and crossing Liao west.
translations.idiomatic: accustomed to Mohe dress, raiding Liao west.

sentences.zh: 又青丘之表，咸修職貢；

translations.literal: Again beyond the blue hills all repaired tribute duty;
translations.idiomatic: Again beyond blue hills all repaired tribute;

sentences.zh: 碧海之濱，同稟正朔。

translations.literal: on the blue sea's edge, together received the correct calendar.
translations.idiomatic: on the blue sea's edge, together received the calendar.

sentences.zh: 遂復寇攘政琛贐，遏絕往來；

translations.literal: then again raiding and seizing tribute and gifts, blocking all coming and going;
translations.idiomatic: then again seizing tribute, blocking coming and going;

sentences.zh: 虐及弗辜，誠而遇禍。

translations.literal: cruelty reaching the innocent, sincerity meeting disaster.
translations.idiomatic: cruelty reaching innocents, sincerity meeting disaster.

sentences.zh: 軺軒奉使，爰暨海東；

translations.literal: carriage envoys on mission reached as far as sea east;
translations.idiomatic: carriage envoys reached sea east;

sentences.zh: 旌節所次，途經籓境；

translations.literal: where banners and staffs halted, the route passed frontier lands;
translations.idiomatic: where banners halted, the route passed frontiers;

sentences.zh: 而擁塞道路，拒絕王人。

translations.literal: yet they blocked roads and refused the king's men.
translations.idiomatic: yet they blocked roads and refused the king's men.

translations.literal: No heart to serve the ruler—how is this the minister's ritual?
translations.idiomatic: No heart to serve the ruler—how is this ministers' ritual?

sentences.zh: 此而可忍，孰不可容！

translations.literal: If this can be borne, what cannot be borne!
translations.idiomatic: If this can be borne, what cannot!

translations.literal: Moreover laws and orders are harsh and cruel, levies and collections heavy and frequent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover laws are harsh, levies heavy.

sentences.zh: 強臣豪族，咸執國均；

translations.literal: Powerful ministers and great clans all hold the state balance;
translations.idiomatic: Powerful ministers hold the state balance;

sentences.zh: 朋黨比周，以之成俗。

translations.literal: factions comparing and circling, thereby becoming custom.
translations.idiomatic: factions comparing, thereby custom.

sentences.zh: 賄貨如市，冤枉莫申。

translations.literal: bribes like a market, wrongs unvoiced.
translations.idiomatic: bribes like a market, wrongs unvoiced.

sentences.zh: 重以仍歲災凶，比屋饑饉；

translations.literal: Added to years of disaster and harm, every house hungry;
translations.idiomatic: Added to years of disaster, every house hungry;

sentences.zh: 兵戈不息，徭役無期。

translations.literal: weapons never ceasing, corvée without term.
translations.idiomatic: weapons never ceasing, corvée without end.

sentences.zh: 力竭轉輸，身填溝壑。

translations.literal: strength exhausted in transport, bodies filling ditches and gullies.
translations.idiomatic: strength exhausted in transport, bodies filling gullies.

sentences.zh: 百姓愁苦，爰誰適從。

translations.literal: The people sorrowful and bitter—whom should they follow?
translations.idiomatic: The people sorrowful—whom should they follow?

sentences.zh: 境內哀惶，不勝其弊。

translations.idiomatic: A secret edict inspected fine girls in Jiang and Huainan; each year they were tribute.

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, colonel posts were established to command valiant fruit.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Li Deyi of Pingyuan gathered tens of thousands as Uncle Bandit and raided Shandong.

translations.literal: Lingwu Bai Yu falsely called himself Slave Bandit and raided pasture horses;
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu Bai Yu called himself Slave Bandit and raided horses;

translations.literal: linking north with Turks, Longyou suffered much from them.
translations.idiomatic: linking north with Turks, Longyou suffered.

translations.literal: General Fan Gui was sent to attack; for years he could not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: General Fan Gui attacked for years without success.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, general amnesty.

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Prince of Dai You and Minister of Punishments Wei Xuan were sent to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Prince You of Dai and Minister Wei Xuan guarded the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以右驍衛將軍李渾為右驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Right Valiant Cavalry General Li Hun was appointed Right Valiant Cavalry Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, General Li Hun became Right Valiant Cavalry commander.

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the second month, Jibei man Han Jinluo gathered tens of thousands as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of month two, Han Jinluo of Jibei gathered tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復宇文述等官爵，又征兵討高麗。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Yuwen Shu and others were restored in office and rank; soldiers were again conscripted to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yuwen Shu was restored; soldiers again attacked Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，濟北人孟海公起兵為盜，眾至數萬。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi of the third month, Jibei Meng Haigong raised troops as bandits, masses reaching tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of month three, Meng Haigong of Jibei raised troops, tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，發丁男十萬城大興。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, a hundred thousand laborers were drafted to wall Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, a hundred thousand laborers walled Daxing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸遼東。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he visited Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, he visited Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 以越王侗、工部尚書樊子蓋鎮東都。

translations.idiomatic: Prince Tong of Yue and Minister Fan Zigai guarded the Eastern Capital.

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Beihai Guo Fangyu gathered followers as bandits, called himself Duke Lu, masses reaching thirty thousand, seized the commandery city, and plundered greatly before leaving.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Guo Fangyu of Beihai gathered thirty thousand, called himself Duke Lu, seized the commandery, and plundered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，車駕度遼。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengwu, the imperial carriage crossed Liao.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month four, on gengwu, the carriage crossed Liao.

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Yuwen Shu and Yang Yichen were sent to hurry to Pyongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Yuwen Shu and Yang Yichen hurried to Pyongyang.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the fifth month, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of month five, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 己卯，濟北人甄寶車聚眾萬餘，寇掠城邑。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Jibei Zhen Baoche gathered more than ten thousand and raided cities.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhen Baoche of Jibei gathered ten thousand and raided cities.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，禮部尚書楊玄感反於黎陽。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the sixth month, Minister of Rites Yang Xuanggan rebelled at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of month six, Minister Yang Xuanggan rebelled at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，玄感逼東都。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Xuanggan pressed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xuanggan pressed the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 河南贊理裴弘策拒之，反為賊所敗。

translations.literal: Henan Assistant Pei Hongce resisted but was defeated by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Assistant Pei Hongce resisted but was defeated.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，兵部侍郎斛斯政奔於高麗。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Vice Minister of War Husiwenzheng fled to Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Vice Minister Husiwenzheng fled to Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上班師。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the army returned.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month seven, on jimao, people were sent to wall counties and posts.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Liu Yuanjin of Yuhang raised tens of thousands.

translations.idiomatic: On renyin of month eight, Yuwen Shu defeated Yang Xuanggan at Wen Township and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: The remaining party was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder was pacified.

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Wu men Zhu Xie and Jinling man Guan Chong held more than a hundred thousand, called themselves generals, and raided the left of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhu Xie and Guan Chong held a hundred thousand and raided the river left.

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, valiant fruit households were exempted from tax.

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, cities far from the road should be moved nearer.

translations.literal: On the day wushen, a statute confiscated bandit households.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, bandit households were confiscated.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Chen Zhen and thirty thousand seized Xin'an.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Minister Zhao Yuansu was executed.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao of month nine, Wu Hailiu and Peng Xiaocai raised tens of thousands.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Liang Huishang gathered forty thousand and seized Cangwu.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the carriage halted at Shanggu.

translations.idiomatic: Supplies failed; the Emperor dismissed Governor Yu He and others.

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Dongyang Li Saner and Xiang Danzi raised troops in disorder, masses reaching more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Li Saner and Xiang Danzi raised over ten thousand.

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jisi, he visited Boling.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jisi, he visited Boling.

translations.idiomatic: Days do not stay; three cycles passed; the past cannot return.

translations.idiomatic: Before words ended, he sobbed.

translations.literal: Attendants all wept, soaking their lapels.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants wept, soaking lapels.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingchou, Lu Mingxing surrounded Dong Commandery; Fei Qingnu beheaded him.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict said, "Boling was Ding Province, a vital point;

translations.literal: the former king tested the foundation here, royal transformation far from there.
translations.idiomatic: the former king tested here, transformation far away.

translations.idiomatic: its Way crowns the Bin ode, above Yao's city.

translations.literal: I tour and comfort the people and come to this land; gazing at the suburbs, I cherish reverent halt.
translations.idiomatic: I tour the people and come here, cherishing halt.

translations.literal: I think to spread celebrating favor, extending to those below;
translations.idiomatic: I think to spread favor below;

translations.literal: exalt records and bright titles to glorify the fine succession.
translations.idiomatic: exalt titles to glorify succession.

translations.literal: Boling may be changed to Gaoyang Commandery; amnesty within the borders for death crimes and below, three years' exemption.

translations.literal: " Thereupon former officials from Gaozu's time were summoned and all appointed by measure of talent.
translations.idiomatic: " Former Gaozu officials were summoned and appointed by talent.

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Counselor Su Wei was appointed Palace Attendant of the First Rank with equal ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Counselor Su Wei became Palace Attendant of the First Rank.

sentences.zh: 朱燮、管崇推劉元進為天子，遣將軍吐萬緒、魚俱羅討之，連年不能克。

translations.literal: Zhu Xie and Guan Chong made Liu Yuanjin emperor; Generals Tu Wanxu and Yu Juluo attacked for years without overcoming them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xie and Guan Chong made Liu Yuanjin emperor; Tu Wanxu attacked for years without success.

translations.literal: Qi men Meng Rang and Wang Bo and others, more than a hundred thousand, held Changbai Mountain and raided commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Rang and Wang Bo held Changbai Mountain with a hundred thousand.

translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jincheng, Ge Qian as Prince of Yan, and Sun Xuanya as Prince of Qi each had a hundred thousand; Shandong suffered.

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Right Martial Guard General Guo Rong was appointed Right Martial Guard Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, General Guo Rong became Right Martial Guard commander.

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the eleventh month, Right Martial Guard General Feng Xiaoci attacked Zhang Jincheng at Qinghe, was defeated by him, and Xiaoci died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of month eleven, Feng Xiaoci attacked Zhang Jincheng at Qinghe, was defeated, and died.

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the twelfth month, Yang Xuanggan's brother Attendant of the Scattered Bureau Jishan and more than ten associates were quartered by cart and their ashes scattered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of month twelve, Jishan and more than ten associates were quartered and their ashes scattered.

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Fufeng man Xiang Haiming raised troops in disorder, called himself emperor, and era name White Crow.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Xiang Haiming of Fufeng rebelled, called himself emperor, era White Crow.

sentences.zh: 遣太僕卿楊義臣擊破之。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Imperial Stud Yang Yichen was sent and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master Yang Yichen was sent and defeated them.

translations.idiomatic: In spring, month one, year ten, on jiayin, a clanswoman became Princess of Trust and married the Turk Yisake Khan.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of month two, an edict ordered deliberation on Goguryeo; for days none spoke.

translations.literal: On the day wuzi an edict said: "Exhausting strength in royal service, giving body to military affairs—all from following righteousness, none not diligent and sincere.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict said, "Exhausting strength in service, giving body to war—all from righteousness, all diligent.

translations.literal: Entrusting life to grass and stalks, exposing bones in the wild;
translations.idiomatic: Life to grass, bones in the wild;

translations.literal: speaking of it brings sighs; each holds pity in the breast.
translations.idiomatic: speaking brings sighs; each holds pity.

translations.literal: In former years questioning guilt, the army was about to reach Liao shore;
translations.idiomatic: Former years questioning guilt, the army neared Liao;

translations.literal: temple calculations and victorious strategy all had advance and halt.
translations.idiomatic: temple strategy had advance and halt.

translations.literal: Yet Liang was deluded and fierce, not knowing success or failure;
translations.idiomatic: Yet Liang was deluded, not knowing success or failure;

translations.literal: Gao Feng was obstinate and fierce, originally without strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Feng was obstinate, without strategy.

translations.literal: Facing three armies was still child's play, viewing human lives as grass and stalks;
translations.idiomatic: Facing three armies as child's play, lives as grass;

translations.idiomatic: not following rules, causing retreat.

translations.literal: Thus the dead were many, not reaching burial.
translations.idiomatic: The dead were many, unburied.

translations.literal: Now envoys should be sent to collect and bury by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Now envoys should collect and bury by routes.

translations.literal: Establish sacrifice in Liaoxi Commandery and one ritual ground.
translations.idiomatic: Establish sacrifice in Liaoxi and one ritual ground.

translations.literal: Grace reaching spring mounds, perhaps easing wrongs of poor souls;
translations.idiomatic: Grace to mounds, easing poor souls;

sentences.zh: 澤及枯骨，用弘仁者之惠。

translations.literal: favor reaching dry bones, to spread the benevolent man's kindness.
translations.idiomatic: favor to dry bones, spreading kindness.

translations.idiomatic: who is not my minister—only separated from teaching.

translations.literal: Tiny Goguryeo, dwelling in remote wilds;
translations.idiomatic: Tiny Goguryeo in remote wilds;

translations.literal: owl-spreading and wolf-devouring, insulting and slow;

translations.idiomatic: Therefore last year the army questioned guilt at Liao;

translations.literal: killing the long serpent at Xuantu, slaughtering the great boar at Xiangping.
translations.idiomatic: killing the serpent at Xuantu, the boar at Xiangping.

sentences.zh: 扶餘眾軍，風馳電逝；

translations.literal: Fuyu hosts, wind-fast and lightning-swift;
translations.idiomatic: Fuyu hosts, wind-fast;

translations.literal: Blue Sea ships and oars struck the rebels' heart;
translations.idiomatic: Blue Sea ships struck the rebels' heart;

translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuan presented shackles, sending sincerity at the gate.

translations.idiomatic: Soon he asked to enter court and return guilt to law.

translations.idiomatic: Yet he favored evil, feasting in poisoned ease.

translations.idiomatic: If this can be borne, what cannot.

translations.literal: At once divide command to six hosts, a hundred routes advancing together.
translations.idiomatic: At once six hosts, a hundred routes advancing.

sentences.zh: 朕當親執武節，臨御諸軍；

translations.literal: I shall personally hold the martial baton and face all hosts;
translations.idiomatic: I shall hold the martial baton and face all hosts;

translations.literal: feed horses at Jiudu, display troops at Liao water;
translations.idiomatic: feed horses at Jiudu, display troops at Liao;

translations.literal: following Heaven's punishment beyond the seas, saving the people from inverted hanging.
translations.idiomatic: following Heaven's punishment, saving people from inverted hanging.

translations.literal: Campaign to correct them;
translations.idiomatic: Campaign to correct;

sentences.zh: 明德以誅之；

translations.literal: bright virtue to execute them;
translations.idiomatic: bright virtue to execute;

translations.literal: only remove the chief villain, the rest are not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: only remove the chief villain, the rest not questioned.

translations.idiomatic: If any understand survival, turn north, they seek fortune.

translations.literal: If they aid evil together and resist the royal host, like fire on the plain, punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: If aiding evil and resisting the royal host, punishment without pardon.

sentences.zh: 有司便宜宣布，咸使知聞。

translations.literal: The responsible offices should promptly announce so all know and hear.
translations.idiomatic: Offices should announce so all know.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，扶風人唐弼舉兵反，眾十萬，推李弘為天子，自稱唐王。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Fufeng man Tang Bi raised troops in rebellion, masses a hundred thousand, made Li Hong emperor, and called himself Prince of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Tang Bi of Fufeng rebelled with a hundred thousand, made Li Hong emperor, and called himself Prince of Tang.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，行幸涿郡。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the third month, he traveled to Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of month three, he traveled to Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，次臨渝宮。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, he halted at Linyu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, he halted at Linyu Palace.

sentences.zh: 親禦戎服，祃祭黃帝，斬叛軍者以釁鼓。

translations.literal: He personally wore martial dress, performed military sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor, and beheaded rebels to smear the drums.
translations.idiomatic: He wore martial dress, sacrificed to the Yellow Emperor, and beheaded rebels for the drums.

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinwei, Pengcheng bandit Zhang Dabiao gathered tens of thousands, held Boxian Mountain as bandits; Yulin governor Dong Chun attacked, defeated, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month four, on xinwei, Zhang Dabiao held Boxian Mountain; Dong Chun defeated and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，車駕次北平。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the imperial carriage halted at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the carriage halted at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，詔舉郡孝悌廉潔各十人。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi of the fifth month, an edict ordered each commandery to present ten filial, dutiful, honest, and clean men.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of month five, each commandery presented ten filial and honest men.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賊帥宋世謨陷瑯邪。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, bandit chief Song Shimou seized Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Song Shimou seized Langye.

sentences.zh: 庚申，延安人劉迦論舉兵反，自稱皇王，建元大世。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yan'an man Liu Galun raised troops, called himself Emperor King, era name Great Age.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Liu Galun of Yan'an rebelled, era Great Age.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，賊帥鄭文雅、林寶護等眾三萬，陷建安郡，太守楊景祥死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the sixth month, bandit chiefs Zheng Wenya and Lin Baohu and others, masses thirty thousand, seized Jian'an Commandery; Governor Yang Jingxiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of month six, Zheng Wenya and Lin Baohu seized Jian'an; Governor Yang Jingxiang died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，車駕次懷遠鎮。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guichou, the imperial carriage halted at Huaiyuan Post.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month seven, on guichou, the carriage halted at Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，曹國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Cao sent an envoy presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Cao sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，高麗遣使請降，囚送斛斯政。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Goguryeo sent an envoy requesting surrender and sent Husiwenzheng bound.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Goguryeo requested surrender and sent Husiwenzheng bound.

sentences.zh: 上大悅。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，班師。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the eighth month, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of month eight, the army returned.

sentences.zh: 右衛大將軍、左光祿大夫鄭榮卒。

translations.literal: Right Guard General, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zheng Rong died.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard General Zheng Rong died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，上至東都。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on the day dingmao, the Emperor reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingmao, he reached the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，還京師。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，支解斛斯政於金光門外。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the eleventh month, Husiwenzheng was dismembered outside the Golden Light Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of month eleven, Husiwenzheng was dismembered outside Golden Light Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, sacrifice was made at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, sacrifice was made at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賊帥司馬長安破長平郡。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, bandit chief Sima Chang'an broke Changping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Sima Chang'an broke Changping.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，離石胡劉苗王舉兵反，自稱天子，以其弟六兒為永安王，眾至數萬。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Lishi Hu Liu Miaowang raised troops, called himself Son of Heaven, made his younger brother Liuer Prince of Yong'an, masses reaching tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liu Miaowang of Lishi rebelled, masses tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 將軍潘長文討之，不能克。

translations.literal: General Pan Changwen attacked but could not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: General Pan Changwen could not overcome them.

sentences.zh: 是月，賊帥王德仁擁眾數萬，保林慮山為盜。

translations.literal: That month, bandit chief Wang Deren held tens of thousands and held Linlu Mountain as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Deren held Linlu Mountain with tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，上如東都，其日大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day renshen of the twelfth month, the Emperor went to the Eastern Capital; that day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of month twelve, he went to the Eastern Capital; that day general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊子，入東都。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, he entered the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he entered the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賊帥孟讓眾十餘萬，據都梁宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, bandit chief Meng Rang, more than a hundred thousand, held Duliang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Meng Rang held Duliang Palace with a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 遣江都丞王世充擊破之，盡虜其眾。

translations.literal: Jiangdu assistant Wang Shichong was sent, defeated them, and captured the entire mass.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong defeated them and captured all.

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, on the day jiawu at the new moon, the hundred officials were feasted.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, month one, year eleven, on jiawu at the new moon, the hundred officials were feasted.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao, barbarians assembled; fish-dragon entertainments; rewards in varying degrees.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of month two, Yang Zhongxu attacked Beiping; Li Jing beheaded them.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict said, "Setting barriers is in former classics;

translations.literal: Therefore dwelling in the land and securing the state, forbidding evil and strengthening the root.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore securing the state and strengthening the root.

translations.idiomatic: Yet in recent wars, dwellers scattered, walls unrepaired.

translations.idiomatic: Thus idleness multiplied and raids did not cease.

translations.literal: Now all under Heaven is one, the interior peaceful;
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is one, the interior peaceful;

translations.literal: it is fitting to order people all to dwell in cities and fields given according to nearness.

translations.literal: Let strong and weak accommodate each other, labor and service mutually aided;
translations.idiomatic: Let strong and weak aid each other;

translations.literal: burglars have no place to set their evil, reeds and rushes cannot gather their fugitives.

translations.idiomatic: Wei Daoer called himself Mountain Flying, each with a hundred thousand, linking Turks and raiding Zhao.

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Right Valiant Cavalry Commander-in-Chief, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Duke of Bin Li Hun, Works Supervisor, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Min were killed, and their clans exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Hun and Li Min were killed and clans exterminated.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賊帥司馬長安破西河。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, bandit chief Sima Chang'an broke Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Sima Chang'an broke Xihe.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸太原，避暑汾陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, he visited Taiyuan and summered at the Fenyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, he visited Taiyuan and summered at Fenyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，淮南人張起緒舉兵為盜，眾至三萬。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jihai, Huainan man Zhang Qixu raised troops as bandits, masses reaching thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month seven, on jihai, Zhang Qixu of Huainan raised thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，光祿大夫、右禦衛大將軍張壽卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Right Imperial Guard Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shou died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Grand Master Zhang Shou died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，巡北塞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, he toured the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In month eight, on yimao, he toured the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬，謀襲乘輿；

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Turk Shibi Khan led several hundred thousand horsemen planning to strike the imperial carriage;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Shibi Khan led hundreds of thousands planning to strike the carriage;

sentences.zh: 義成公主遣使告變。

translations.literal: Princess Yicheng sent an envoy reporting the change.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Yicheng sent word of the plot.

sentences.zh: 壬申，車駕馳幸雁門。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the imperial carriage galloped to Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the carriage galloped to Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，突厥圍城，官軍頻戰不利。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Turks surrounded the city; government troops repeatedly fought without success.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Turks surrounded the city; troops fought without success.

sentences.zh: 上大懼，欲率精騎潰圍而出；

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly afraid and wished to lead elite horsemen to burst out;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wished to burst out with elite horsemen;

translations.literal: Minister of the People Fan Zigai firmly remonstrated, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Fan Zigai remonstrated, and he stopped.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Yang of Qi held the rear at Guo County.

translations.literal: Thereupon governors and magistrates each came to the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and magistrates each came to the crisis.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，突厥解圍而去。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the ninth month, the Turks lifted the siege and left.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of month nine, Turks lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 丁未，曲赦太原、雁門死罪已下。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, a partial amnesty for Taiyuan and Yanmen for death crimes and below.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, partial amnesty for Taiyuan and Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，上至於東都。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on the day renxu, the Emperor reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renxu, he reached the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘為盜，寇魯郡。

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wei Qilin of Pengcheng raided Lu.

translations.literal: On the day renshen, bandit chief Lu Mingyue gathered more than a hundred thousand and raided between Chen and Ru.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Lu Mingyue gathered a hundred thousand and raided Chen and Ru.

translations.idiomatic: Li Zitong crossed the Huai, called himself Prince of Chu, and raided Jiangdu.
